name: Hornero Equalizer
description: A live spectrum analyser for the bar and its popover over the shell's real PipeWire spectrum. Honest by design: an analyser, not a sound filter; it draws nothing while nothing plays and holds the analyser only while a player is playing.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: bar equalizer bars and a popover analyser over Audio.spectrum, peak-hold ticks derived from the real samples, spectrum lease held only while a player is playing by default.

barBands.description: How many bands the bar indicator draws.

popoverBands.description: How many bands the popover analyser draws.

peakHold.description: Draw a peak tick above each popover band, derived from recent real samples.

analyseWhen.description: playing runs the shared analyser only while a media player plays; always also covers apps without a player.

whenSilent.description: glyph keeps the indicator button while silent; hide removes it until sound plays.
